guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Open Your Infinex Account
guide.description: Go to the Infinex platform , pick a username, and create a passkey to set up your account. If you already have one, log in and head to the dashboard.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Your Patron Allocation
guide.description: If you held a Patron or µPatron NFT at the January 30 snapshot, claim your 100,000 INX per Patron directly in the app. Patrons held outside your Infinex account can be claimed at app.magna.so. You keep the NFT after claiming, and it becomes a PFP collectible.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Redeem Your INX Vouchers
guide.description: Open the app and go to the Crates page . Select how many of each voucher type you want to redeem, then complete checkout to convert them into INX at the listed price. Vouchers are valid from TGE and expire on January 30, 2027 Each voucher type locks in a different fixed FDV, so check the price before redeeming
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Enable Funds Recovery
guide.description: Open “Settings,” turn on “Funds Recovery,” and add a recovery address. This lets you withdraw funds later if you lose access to your passkey.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund Your Account
guide.description: Go to “Deposit,” choose a network, and send supported assets to the generated address. You can buy most assets on Binance or move them over using the bridge widget below if they sit on another chain. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade Perps to Earn Crates
guide.description: Craterun continues after TGE, so you keep earning INX vouchers by trading. Trade perpetual futures on Infinex to accrue crates, then open them for vouchers, cash draw tickets, and NFT prizes. Import existing perps wallets from Hyperliquid, Drift, or Synthetix More trading volume means faster crate accrual
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
